title: A photon's wavelength
hook: Change vacuum wavelength and predict photon momentum magnitude.
misconception: photon momentum magnitude doubles when vacuum wavelength doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply p = h/λ to compare photon momentum magnitude when vacuum wavelength changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a photon in vacuum, p = h/λ. When vacuum wavelength doubles, photon momentum magnitude becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model p = h/λ; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a photon in vacuum, with a nonzero initial result. If vacuum wavelength triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on photon momentum magnitude?
recall.why: Apply p = h/λ under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
